question: The former captain of the Indian women’s hockey team __________ was conferred with the BBC Lifetime Achievement Award for her contribution to Indian sports and inspiring generations of players.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Pritam Siwach**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Pritam Siwach** was conferred with the BBC Lifetime Achievement Award for her contribution to Indian sports and inspiring generations of players.
 
• She is a **former captain of the Indian women's hockey team**.
